recipes.description: You get fired.' At least now I can explore the internet. [Surfing is unlocked.]

recipes.label: Surfing the Web 90s style
recipes.comments: 10s after intro triggered. It directly switches to surfing the deep web, and getting a bill. Displayed cards should be Health Funds Passion, and funds is immediately eaten by bill

recipes.label: Your employer is demanding your wage back
recipes.startdescription: Your employer is trying to take back your wages.
recipes.description: You have no way to fight it. Now you're penniless.
recipes.comments: 20s after intro triggered. You lose all your pay from your job, making you go to the deep web. Should use greedy slot for funds

recipes.label: Surfing the Deep Web
recipes.startdescription: I'm about to be homeless, searching the deep web for possible work or distractions.
recipes.description: I found an amazing website. A website that claims to be run by an immortal catgirl here to save humanity from evil aliens. Now to sleep on it. I feel a profound sense of hope from the website [Dreaming is unlocked.]
recipes.comments: 20s after intro triggered. This is only triggered in the catgirl intro.

recipes.label: Recall my Dreams
recipes.startdescription: As I dream only the catgirls are present. Then I see moving across all the universe cats and snakes.
recipes.description:
I wake up from the dream and it all makes sense. This is the time I have been waiting for my entire life. My mind is clear and my thoughts content.
[Time is now passing.]
recipes.comments: 50s after intro triggered. This is triggered from the intro work recipe only. Finishes 110s after intro triggered resulting in order: Health, Reason, Passion, Contentment

recipes.label: A Change in the Air
recipes.startdescription: I set up a gofundme to support myself. Maybe people will support me

recipes.label: A Bequest Arrives
recipes.startdescription: I got an email. An anonymous donor sent me a large sum of money. But they have conditions
recipes.description: I have the money I need to survive. But the donor told me to use my time to study what they sent me. A mysterious videogame. Many pdfs and videos on philosophical topics. [Study is unlocked.]
recipes.comments: This makes the Study action available, and is triggered from intro only. When this appears the contentment runs out.

recipes.label: Examine the Bequest, employing Reason
recipes.startdescription: I'll examine each item with meticulous care.
recipes.description: My correspondent describes my dreams exactly! They use names that are instantly familiar - the House, the Wood, the Hours, the Glory. They knew secrets beneath time and the skin of the world. A new curiosity burns in me. There is a note here - directions to a book shop that does not advertise its wares -

recipes.label: Examine my Bequest, employing Passion
recipes.startdescription: I'll read, theorise, pace, sketch, clutch at my hair in wonder, rise in elation, collapse in despair.
recipes.description: My correspondent describes my dreams exactly! They use names that are instantly familiar - the House, the Wood, the Hours, the Glory. I sense here a power that generals and kings would envy. A new desire burns in me. There is a note here - directions to a book shop that does not advertise its wares -

recipes.label: Find a potential collaborator
recipes.startdescription: I have a name, a description, a few tantalising details... but there are a thousand thousand faces in this city.
recipes.description: And now I have an address! I'll dispatch a letter and propose a meeting. [ Talk is unlocked].
recipes.comments: This is one way the Talk verb may be opened.
